csv_scope_of_work: Contractor will be required to furnish the design and all materials, labor, freight, and equipment necessary to erect a sixty-five-foot by sixty-foot by 18-foot (65 x 60 x 18 ) single slope heated and insulated metal building; must meet acceptable snow and wind loads; meeting AISC requirement for steel buildings. Design shall include four overhead and three personnel doors, windows, pipe bollards, drains, plumbing rough-in, electrical and restroom

title: Design and Construct for Waterways Response Shed
short_description: Design-build procurement for a heated insulated metal response shed in Rigby, Idaho.
project_scope: Design and construction of a single-slope heated and insulated metal building measuring 65 ft x 60 ft x 18 ft. The building must satisfy applicable snow and wind loads and meet AISC requirements for steel buildings. Scope includes four overhead doors, three personnel doors, windows, pipe bollards, drains, plumbing rough-in, electrical works, and a restroom.
services: Design-build services including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering, plus furnishing all materials, labor, freight, and equipment for construction.
relevance_explanation:
- Small utilitarian metal building with limited structural ambition.
- No long spans, special structural systems, or architecturally demanding features indicated.
- Includes design services, but focus is general building delivery rather than advanced structural engineering.
- Building type is not among sbp's priority sectors such as bridges, stadiums, long-span roofs, or major cultural/university buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available scope for a rough estimate: 3,900 sq ft heated insulated steel building, 18 ft height, design-build delivery, includes doors, windows, bollards, drains, plumbing rough-in, electrical, and restroom.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. Since no construction budget or fee basis is provided, a reliable sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Bidder must provide design and construction for a steel building meeting snow and wind loads and AISC requirements. No explicit minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: Jefferson County Commissioners Office, Jefferson County, Idaho. Contact: Samuel Scott. Phone: 208-745-9222. Email: sascott@co.jefferson.id.us. Website: https://www.jcgov.us/bids.aspx?bidID=8
notes: Project number: JC2026-1. Target market: General Building. Questions deadline: 2026-07-14 05:00 PM MDT. Solicitation documents available online.
